Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
Faster AutoRefresh: matching stacks reuse verified external competitor quotes for up to two minutes, including across retainers. Own retainers stay excluded; context changes and expiry force new lookups. Already-competitive duplicates can skip the editor.
Removed the 200-item approved AutoList cap, including saved character profiles and AutoTidy adoption.
Fixed HQ listing submission by resolving canonical names from item IDs instead of comparing saved HQ labels with game symbols. Added specific submission rejection diagnostics.
All 173 automated regression checks pass. Released for in-game testing; native smoke tests remain pending.
